final: WITH t AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS tot FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), s AS (SELECT st, tot, tot * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(tot) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.tot) AS combined_total, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_above, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
